categories.question: At a neighbourhood seed swap, you can take home only one packet. What do you choose?

outcomes.name: Rainbow carrot seeds
outcomes.description: Open plain seed packet decorated with drawn carrots beside purple, yellow and orange carrots

outcomes.name: Striped sunflower seeds
outcomes.description: Pale wooden scoop filled with black-and-white striped sunflower seeds beside a sunflower head

outcomes.name: Dwarf bean seeds
outcomes.description: Handful of maroon speckled beans beside a short curling green bean pod

outcomes.name: Nasturtium seeds
outcomes.description: Few rounded wrinkled pale seeds beside an orange nasturtium flower with a round green leaf
